learning_outcomes.text: Students who successfully complete this course will know the structures of DC generators.
Students who successfully complete this course will know the structures of DC motors.
Students who successfully complete this course will know the operating principles of generators and motors.
Students who successfully complete this course will know the operating characteristics of generators and motors.
Students who successfully complete this course will be able to determine the polarities of transformers.
Students who successfully complete this course will know the connections of transformers.
Students who successfully complete this course will know the characteristics of transformers.

syllabus_topics: Transformer open circuit and short circuit tests with DC experiment
No-load experiment of externally excited DC generators
External characteristics of externally excited DC generators
bibliography: Elektrik Makineleri, Fitzgerald, Charles Kingsley, Stephen D.Umans, Electrical Machines with MATLAB, Turan Gönen
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
